-versus-
State of Odisha ....
Opposite Party Mr. S. Panda, Asc Coram: Justice V. Narasingh Order
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioners are seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.2468 of 2024 pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C, Khallikote, arising out of Rambha P.S. Case. No.815 of 2024 for commission of offences punishable U/s. 465/ 467/ 468/ 471/ 417/ 418/ 420/ 120-B/ 34 IPC.
3.

It is submitted by the learned counsel that one of the co-accused, namely, Puspalata Maharathi @
Pallai was released on pre-arrest bail vide order dated 10.12.2025 in ABLAPL No.13794 of 2025.
Hence, on the ground of parity, the Petitioner seeks release.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for pre-arrest bail.

5. Taking into account the nature of allegations and the background in which the same is leveled, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the Petitioner in connection with the aforesaid case, she shall be released on bail by the Arresting Officer on such terms and conditions deemed just and proper with further conditions that she will cooperate with the investigation.
6. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
U.C.C. as per rules.
